name: Steamed Taro Root Mash (Traditional Poi Style)
whyItWorks: Thoroughly cooked taro root pureed smooth with water into traditional soothing poi. One of the world's most hypoallergenic, easy-to-absorb starches, renowned in pediatric and gastrointestinal recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel taro with gloves, steam for 30 minutes until soft, and blend in a food processor with warm water and salt until silky smooth.
